title: 《物种起源》— 好书精读 Read 53
title_en: On the Origin of Species — Deep Reading Read 53

questions.question: 《物种起源》的两层主张，在当时的科学界分别受到怎样的对待？
options: 两层都被冷落了四十年，直到 1900 年孟德尔被重新发现后，才同时得到科学界承认
自然选择很快被接受，因为它的四步推理无懈可击；共同由来争议最大，一直要等到后来的化石记录补全
物种会变、且出自共同祖先，很快被接受；自然选择是主要机制，争议最大，直到 20 世纪才坐实
两层都在出版后不久被普遍接受，只有宗教界持续反对，科学界内部并无实质分歧
questions.explanation: 文章强调要分清两层：共同由来靠多学科证据汇聚，当时几乎立刻被接受，是更革命也更快被接受的部分；自然选择逻辑上严密，但缺遗传机制，直到与遗传学合流才被坐实。很多批评打的只是第二层。
questions.question_en: How did scientists of the time respond to the two layers of claims in On the Origin of Species?
options_en: Both were ignored for forty years and only accepted together after Mendel was rediscovered in 1900
Natural selection was accepted quickly because its four-step logic was airtight; common descent stayed contested until fossils filled in
Change and common descent were accepted quickly; natural selection as the main mechanism stayed contested until the 20th century
Both were widely accepted soon after publication; only religious critics objected, with no real dispute among scientists
questions.explanation_en: The article stresses separating the two layers. Common descent rested on converging evidence from many fields and was accepted almost at once. Natural selection was logically tight but lacked a mechanism of heredity, and was only confirmed once it merged with genetics. Many critiques hit only the second layer.

questions.question: 按文章对达尔文论证的解读，真正压垮「物种分别被创造」说的最硬证据是哪一类？
options: 完整的化石序列：一步步记录了每个物种从祖先变来的全部过渡
生物的精巧：像眼睛、蜂房这类结构，精密到接近数学上的最优设计方案
生物的「凑合」：同源结构共用一套骨头、痕迹器官留着没用的零件
人工选择的成果：育种者在几百年里造出了形态迥异的家鸽品种
questions.explanation: 精巧两边都能解释（设计者做的或选择筛的），凑合只有一边能解释：人手、蝙蝠翼、鲸鳍沿用同一套骨头，痕迹器官像不发音的字母，泄露了来历。文章还指出达尔文自己承认化石记录很不完整。
questions.question_en: In the article's reading of Darwin, what kind of evidence most decisively undercuts the idea that species were separately created?
options_en: A complete fossil sequence recording every transition from ancestor to each living species
How exquisite organisms are: eyes and honeycombs so precise they approach mathematically optimal designs
How makeshift organisms are: homologous limbs sharing one set of bones, vestigial organs keeping useless parts
The results of artificial selection: breeders producing wildly different pigeon breeds over centuries
questions.explanation_en: Exquisite design fits both explanations (a designer or a sieve); makeshift design fits only one. Human hands, bat wings and whale flippers reuse one set of bones, and vestigial organs are like silent letters that betray a word's origin. Darwin himself conceded the fossil record was badly incomplete.

questions.question: 海岛上常有大量特有的鸟类、昆虫和植物，却几乎没有本土的陆生哺乳类和两栖类。达尔文怎样解释这个模式？
options: 哺乳类和两栖类曾在岛上出现，但被更善于竞争的鸟类和昆虫排挤灭绝
每座岛按自身环境被分别安排了合适的物种，哺乳类不在那份清单之中
岛屿物种是少数渡海拓殖者的后代，渡不过海的类群就一个也不会有
海岛气候和资源不适合哺乳类与两栖类生存，所以那里没有它们的位置
questions.explanation: 达尔文指出岛上完全有这些类群的位置，按环境需要「造物」解释不了它们的缺席；共同由来的解释是现成的：岛屿生物是从大陆漂来、飞来、被风吹来的拓殖者后代。所以岛上物种像最近的大陆邻居，带的是血统而非环境的订单。
questions.question_en: Oceanic islands often have many endemic birds, insects and plants but almost no native land mammals or amphibians. How did Darwin explain this pattern?
options_en: Mammals and amphibians once lived there but were outcompeted to extinction by birds and insects
Each island was stocked with species suited to its environment, and mammals weren't on that list
Island species descend from a few colonists that crossed the sea; groups that can't cross never arrive
Island climates and resources can't support mammals and amphibians, so there is no niche for them
questions.explanation_en: Darwin argued the islands had room for these groups, so creation-to-fit-the-environment can't explain their absence. Common descent can: island life descends from colonists that drifted, flew or blew in from the mainland. That's why island species resemble their nearest mainland neighbors: they carry ancestry, not an environmental order form.
